name: What should I ask a contractor before starting a guest bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What are the most important questions to ask a contractor before hiring them for a guest bathroom remodel?
mainEntity.text: What are the most important questions to ask a contractor before hiring them for a guest bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a contractor for a guest bathroom remodel, focus on scope, process, and accountability. Ask who will manage permits and inspections, whether the bathroom layout will stay the same, and exactly how waterproofing is handled in showers and wet areas. Ask for the written scope so you can see what is included, what is excluded, and what allowances are built in for tile, fixtures, and finishes. You should also understand how change orders work if hidden damage appears after demolition. In older homes, that detail matters because rot, old plumbing, or electrical issues can surface quickly. Ask who supervises the job daily, how communication happens, and what warranty or follow-up support applies after completion. A contractor who answers clearly and in writing usually reduces surprises later. For homeowners in Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, Burbank, and North Hollywood, a detailed upfront conversation is one of the best ways to protect budget and schedule.
